productFit.name: DWARFLAB Mini Tripod with Hydraulic Head
productFit.metricSpecs: DWARFLAB: folds to 25 cm, 360° pan, +90°/-75° tilt, head 300 g; the English post keeps 775 g, 53 cm and 3,0 kg from DWARFLAB's US page, keep those.
productFit.reason: DWARFLAB runs EU country stores (e.g. the Slovak store) with the same Mini Tripod page; a German Astrotreff owner ordered it directly from DWARFLAB.

productFit.reason: Manfrotto lists the kit as MK290XTA3-3W on its non-US store pages; the product images are named mk290xta3-3w.

productFit.metricSpecs: Astroshop gives 69,5-121,5 cm and 1,8 kg (retailer, not maker); keep the English figures 63,5-113,7 cm and 2,35 kg so numbers match the English post.

localFacts.fact: Iberia allows a cabin bag of up to 10 kg and max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm; by folded length the DWARFLAB Mini Tripod (25 cm), the K&F Concept (39,5 cm) and the Befree Advanced (40 cm) fit, the 290 Xtra (70,6 cm) does not.

Mainland Spain spans from 36°00' N (Isla de Tarifa) to 43°47' N (Estaca de Bares), so the EQ-mode tilt to latitude is roughly 36 to 44 degrees on the peninsula (about 40° in Madrid, 41° in Barcelona, 37° in Sevilla).
Since 2014 the sky of the Parque Nacional del Teide is a 'Destino Starlight'; the cable-car base station at about 2.356 m is used for guided stargazing.

Spanish shops such as Astroshop.es sell the DWARF 3 (art. 83412); Spanish terms: trípode, columna central, rótula de bola, rótula de 3 vías / de tres ejes, cabezal hidráulico, rosca de 1/4", placa de liberación rápida, modo ecuatorial (EQ), puesta en estación, latitud.

localPainPoints.pain: Spanish owners note that the 60 s EQ exposures depend on mechanical stability and polar alignment, not just the scope.
localPainPoints.fix: Firm legs, column down, a head that holds latitude (290 Xtra 3-way head) and weight under the tripod in wind.

quotes.text: la estabilidad mecánica, la alineación polar y las condiciones ambientales siguen condicionando la calidad de las tomas.

localPainPoints.pain: Setting the latitude angle in EQ mode is the step owners find fiddly with a ball head.
localPainPoints.fix: A 3-way head sets tilt on one handle; in mainland Spain tilt roughly 36 to 44 degrees.

quotes.text: Tripod ball head will work. Pan and tilt head will make it easier

localGain.point: The EQ tilt angle for mainland Spain (about 36 to 44 degrees, by city).
